title: Colts trade Zaire Franklin to Packers in player-for-player swap

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts trade Zaire Franklin to Packers in player-for-player swap
sources.description: The Packers and Colts orchestrated a player-for-player trade ahead of 2026 NFL free agency, with Zaire Franklin and Colby Wooden swapping teams.
